messages:
maya: customer reported 403 on SSO after IdP cert rotation, started ~1728604200. web login redirect lands back at /login with `SAMLResponse validation failed: Signature verification failed`
alex: can you paste the raw error / request id?
maya: request_id: req_0a9f, tenant=acme-inc. From auth-proxy logs: `saml.verify: thumbprint mismatch expected=0A:3B:... got=9F:77:...`
jordan: that usually means our metadata cache is stale or the KeyDescriptor order changed in the IdP metadata. did the customer rotate signing keys yesterday?
maya: they said yes, rotation finished at 1728603600. Their metadata endpoint shows the new key, but our internal /metadata/tenant/acme still returns the old thumbprint on two edge nodes
lina_support: they also noted Set-Cookie not present on final redirect for web. mobile app gets 403 immediately.
carlos_oncall: probable simultaneous issues: (1) metadata cached at CDN edge, (2) auth-proxy picks first KeyDescriptor regardless of use attribute, and the IdP switched order during rotation, (3) cookie domain rewrite on proxy may hide auth cookie.
maya: repro steps I ran locally: 1) fetch IdP metadata 2) craft SAMLResponse signed with new key 3) POST to /saml/acs -> 403 and same signature error. 4) POST to our canary where I invalidated metadata -> 200
alex: immediate mitigation options: a) invalidate metadata cache for tenant on control plane, b) hotpatch auth-proxy to prefer KeyDescriptor[@use='signing'] and accept any matching cert thumbprint in tenant trustlist, c) ask customer to clear sessions/cookies.
lina_support: customer tried clearing cookies and reauth, web works intermittently. mobile fails until app cache cleared. they are on an older CDN edge config.
eng-infra-bot: INFRA-1129 created: "metadata-cache invalidation not triggered by idp cert rotation"
jordan: I'm running the invalidate command now: `curl -X POST "https://control.redwood/api/internal/tenants/acme/cache/invalidate?key=metadata" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP"` -> 200 OK
jordan: hotfix deployed to canary auth-proxy: prefer KeyDescriptor with use=\"signing\"; canary logs show `saml.verify: matched cert thumbprint=9F:77` and validation passed
maya: ran through customer flow, web login succeeded after cache invalidate. mobile required app cache clear; explained steps to customer.
carlos_oncall: followup actions: 1) add automatic metadata invalidation hook on IdP cert rotation events, 2) patch parser to prefer explicit use=\"signing\", 3) add monitoring alert when signature thumbprints change for a tenant, 4) document cookie-domain caveats for ACS behind proxies.
alex: please file a short postmortem and update support KB with step-by-step mitigations and the short-term env var workaround: `REDWOOD_TRUSTED_IDP_CERTS` to temporarily trust new thumbprint without restart.
maya: will draft postmortem and KB. marking thread resolved for now; will reopen if mobile still reports failures. :thumbsup:
